column16:
Morning sits quietly around the tied boats, the water moving just enough to catch the blue light. Along the dock, ropes, weathered posts, and painted edges hold the scene close, while the boats rest in place with their red-orange trim and deep navy shadows.

Painted in Portland Old Port, Maine, this original oil on canvas carries the stillness of a working harbor before the day fully begins. The composition feels close and grounded, focused less on the sweep of the coast and more on the pause beside the dock.
